text_block_list.text:
As part of her studies, I brought Oguri 
Cap along to watch the race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So the course is shaped like an onigiri. 
...Fascinating.
choice_data_list:
You can buy real onigiri inside the venue 
too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I hear Nakayama Racecourse has an 
abundance of gourmet food. I'm looking 
forward to it, Trainer.
choice_data_list:
Let's look around the shops until it 
starts.

text_block_list.text:
"With an eager, wide-eyed Oguri Cap in 
tow, we toured around the dining area 
inside the racetrack."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's almost starting time. I wonder if I 
can visit a few more stalls...
choice_data_list:
Let's head over early to secure a viewing 
spot.
Let's enjoy the races and the food!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... I see. Today's main purpose is 
spectating, after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I still have some regrets, but I'll be 
fine. Let's head to the stands, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And suddenly, Akemichi King shoots out 
from the back of the pack!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Akemi... "Chicken"... He's yellow...!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Noppo Tetra follows right behind!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No... "Potato"...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Chicken... fries... Piping hot, fresh out 
of the fryer...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... No, never mind. Let's just watch 
the race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Chicken... or fries... Both Uma Musume 
make a compelling case, but—

I had a feeling there were major problems 
with this, but I decided to put my faith 
in Oguri Cap and watch over her.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's coming down to the wire. Will it be 
the chicken, or the fries...?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Akemichi King! Akemichi 
Kiiingーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So the chicken won after all...! Just as I 
predicted, Trainer.

She seemed to be watching the race while 
fighting off the temptation of food 
through sheer willpower.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Potato ran a marvelous race as well, 
however. I must learn from her example—
(Grrrumble~)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ......I'm getting hungry.

As a reward for watching so earnestly, I 
decided to treat her to dinner.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, of course.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There are still shops I scouted out. Let's 
visit as many as we can before the race 
starts.

I went around the restaurants with Oguri 
Cap, who moved with uncharacteristic 
sharpness.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like the race is just getting 
started. ...Alright, let's watch closely."
choice_data_list: You're fully fired up, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Maybe it's because I ate to my 
heart's content, but my mind feels much 
sharper than usual.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Wondering what the runner in second place 
will do next, or who might break out from 
the rear pack... things like that."
choice_data_list: Who do you think will win, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's see... Given the current flow—

Since we were at it, the two of us decided 
to trade predictions on the outcome of the 
match.
And after the final race concluded—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I was right again, huh... She was keeping 
to the outside the whole time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It looks easier to run on the outside 
here, so I thought she'd have the 
advantage.
choice_data_list: We analyzed it perfectly, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. When I run here, I should be able to 
deliver great results.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I believe I can run a race that makes my 
Trainer, everyone back home, and all the 
fans cheering for me proud.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So let's keep training hard from here on 
out too...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Traine... *yaaawn*...

Perhaps from concentrating and working her 
brain right after eating, Oguri Cap seemed 
to be getting sleepy.

Imagining a future where the venue would 
be filled with chants of 'Oguri!', the two 
of them left the stands.
